request.spec:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each sheet has a "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there. It starts as the real
date. Every decision in the app that depends on the date, and every default date, uses the
sheet's today and never the real clock.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each sheet now has its own "today" date, shown on the screen and changeable there, and the acceptance test passes when run with `bin/e2e`.

- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V2__sheet_today.sql`, adds a required `today` date to each sheet. A new sheet's today is set to the real date when it is first loaded.
- **Server:**
  - Loading a sheet now also returns its today.
  - A new `PUT /api/sheets/{id}/today` call changes it.
  - `SheetService.today(id)` gives the sheet's date for any server code that needs one.
- **Screen:** the sheet bar shows the date (`sheet-today`) with a date field and save button (`sheet-today-input`, `sheet-today-save`). If a change is refused, a `sheet-error` message appears; it goes away when the field is edited, the form is submitted again, or a sheet is loaded.

The app has no date-dependent features yet (no claims or plans), so nothing else uses the date for now. Later features should take it from `SheetService.today(id)` on the server and from `Session.today()` in the front end, not from the real clock. If a sheet doesn't exist yet, `SheetService.today(id)` falls back to the real date. Changing the date writes nothing to the audit file, because the test doesn't expect a record for it.
